use_case: Water-quality anomaly detection: scores turbidity, chlorine and chloramine residual, pH, and flow signals every minute and alerts ROC operators
business_owner: Water Utility VP of Water Quality and Compliance
vendor_or_model: In-house model on the group data platform (SYS-G3), trained on historian data
data_categories: Process and water quality data from historian replicas at the 6 largest systems; no personal data
affects_individuals: Yes (indirectly: the people served by the 6 systems)
human_in_the_loop: Advisory only: operators decide every action; the model never changes setpoints; SCADA alarms, hardwired analyzer alarms, and grab samples remain the controls of record
applicable_laws: SDWA section 1433 (RRA monitoring practices 300i-2(a)(1)(A)(iii); ERP detection strategies 300i-2(b)(4)); 40 CFR 141.202 (Tier 1 decisions stay with people); no sector AI rule identified
status: In production at 6 systems since 2026-03-02; continue with conditions; no expansion until validation is complete (POAM-028)

vendor_or_model: Asset management vendor model, configured with break and soil data
data_categories: Pipe attributes, break history, soil and pressure data; no personal data
human_in_the_loop: Engineers review every ranking before it enters the capital plan; rate filings use engineering judgment
applicable_laws: State utility commission rate rules (generic); no AI-specific law
